coverage_notes: Conducted exhaustive search across foundational theory, canonical authors, peer-reviewed venues, and specific interaction techniques. Swept angles: (1) Foundational visualization theory and seminal authors (Shneiderman, Munzner, Tufte, Norman, Chi, Pirolli); (2) Core interaction techniques (pan/zoom/filter, focus+context, brushing/linking, semantic zooming, fisheye, degree-of-interest); (3) Graph layout and aesthetics (force-directed, hierarchical clustering, edge bundling, layout quality metrics); (4) Large-scale graph handling (abstraction, aggregation, summarization, scalable rendering); (5) Representation trade-offs (node-link vs. matrix, hierarchical graphs, compound graphs); (6) User evaluation and cognitive aspects (path tracing, node counting, comprehension tasks, preattentive processing, visual encoding effectiveness); (7) Specific systems and applications (D3.js, Gephi, Cytoscape, NodeXL, biological networks, social networks); (8) Dynamic and temporal graphs (animation, mental map preservation, layout stability); (9) Visual query and exploration systems (direct manipulation, visual query builders, pattern search); (10) Cognitive and HCI foundations (affordances, discoverability, sensemaking, information foraging, spatial memory). Deduplication applied across search results; organized by tier and license. Notable authorities covered: Ben Shneiderman (direct manipulation, treemaps, dynamic queries), Tamara Munzner (visualization design framework, H3 system, graph layout), Ed Chi (information scent, information foraging), Peter Pirolli (sensemaking, information foraging), Edward Tufte (visual integrity, data-ink ratio), Donald Norman (interaction design principles), Helen Purchase (graph aesthetics empirical evaluation), William Cleveland/Robert McGill (perceptual effectiveness), Jacques Bertin (visual variables), Geoff Furnas (degree-of-interest formalism). Survey papers by von Landesberger et al., Beck et al., and others provide comprehensive reviews. Notable gaps: some paywalled papers behind ACM/IEEE gates (reference-only marked); some conference proceedings require institutional access; limited coverage of emerging AI/ML approaches for graph visualization (still maturing). Open-access and arXiv versions prioritized where available.

sources.title: Interactive Visualization of Large Graphs and Networks
sources.notes: Munzner's foundational PhD thesis (2000) on scalable visualization of large graphs using 3D hyperbolic geometry, focus+context, and efficient rendering; introduces H3 system and principles for interactive graph exploration

sources.title: Visualization Analysis and Design
sources.notes: Comprehensive textbook synthesizing visualization theory and design principles; foundational framework for understanding interaction design, visual encoding, and task-data mapping

sources.title: Tree Visualization with Tree-Maps: 2-D Space-Filling Approach
sources.notes: Seminal paper on treemaps combined with interactive exploration; demonstrates direct manipulation principles and dynamic queries for hierarchical data visualization

sources.title: Ben Shneiderman – Information Visualization and Interaction Pioneer
sources.notes: Personal research page and publications by founding father of information visualization; includes work on dynamic query sliders, treemaps, NodeXL, and direct manipulation principles

sources.title: H3: Laying Out Large Directed Graphs in 3D Hyperbolic Space
sources.notes: Introduces H3 system leveraging hyperbolic geometry for focus+context visualization of 100K+ node graphs; key technique for scalable interactive exploration

sources.title: Browser-based Hyperbolic Visualization of Graphs
sources.notes: Modern web-based implementation of hyperbolic graph visualization using inverse projections and force-directed algorithms; demonstrates scalable interactive exploration in browser

sources.title: Search, Show Context, Expand on Demand: Supporting Large Graph Exploration with Degree-of-Interest
sources.notes: Applies Furnas degree-of-interest formalism to large graphs; enables context-aware interactive exploration by computing node importance based on user focus and graph distance

sources.title: Fisheye Tree Views and Lenses for Graph Visualization
sources.notes: Foundational work on fisheye distortion for focus+context; smooth magnification and compression enabling both detail and context in single view

sources.title: A New 3D Geometric Approach to Focus+Context Lens Effect Simulation
sources.notes: Geometric framework for implementing focus+context distortions; advances in rendering techniques for smooth interactive lens effects

sources.title: Force-Directed Edge Bundling for Graph Visualization
sources.notes: Key technique for reducing visual clutter in dense graphs by bundling similar edges; demonstrates effectiveness for revealing high-level patterns

sources.title: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Evaluating Edge Bundling Visualization
sources.notes: Evaluates edge bundling effectiveness using information theory; provides metrics for assessing pattern clarity in bundled edge visualizations

sources.title: Semantic Zooming for Ontology Graph Visualizations
sources.notes: Demonstrates semantic zooming enabling progressive disclosure of graph structure; different visualizations at different zoom levels prevent visual overload

sources.title: Hierarchical Clustering for Graph Visualization
sources.notes: Uses hierarchical clustering to create multiple abstraction levels; enables navigation from high-level clusters to detailed node-link views

sources.title: NodeTrix: Hybrid Representation for Analyzing Social Networks
sources.notes: Combines node-link diagrams with adjacency matrices; addresses limitations of both representations through hybrid interactive approach

sources.title: Matrices or Node-Link Diagrams: Which Visual Representation is Better for Visualising Connectivity Models?
sources.notes: Empirical evaluation comparing node-link and matrix representations; identifies trade-offs for different graph tasks and network sizes

sources.title: Dynamic Graph Exploration by Interactively Linked Node-Link Diagrams and Matrix Visualizations
sources.notes: Demonstrates linked coordination between complementary representations for enhanced exploratory analysis

sources.title: Community Detection and Visualization in Social Networks: Integrating Structural and Semantic Information
sources.notes: Integrates clustering algorithms with visualization for discovering and exploring community structure in networks

sources.title: A Taxonomy and Survey of Dynamic Graph Visualization
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey categorizing temporal graph visualization approaches (animation vs. small multiples) with analysis of interaction patterns

sources.title: Mental Map-Preserving Visualization through a Genetic Algorithm
sources.notes: Addresses key challenge in dynamic graphs: maintaining user's spatial mental model during layout updates to aid recognition and understanding

sources.title: Animated Transitions in Statistical Data Graphics
sources.notes: Foundational work on animation effectiveness; demonstrates how staged transitions with visual continuity support user comprehension and mental map preservation

sources.title: Common Fate for Animated Transitions in Visualization
sources.notes: Applies animation principles (common fate) to improve perception of object correspondence across graph transitions

sources.title: The State of the Art in Empirical User Evaluation of Graph Visualizations
sources.notes: Meta-analysis of empirical studies on graph visualization effectiveness; synthesizes findings on task performance, visual design impact, and evaluation methodologies

sources.title: A Survey of Perception-Based Visualization Studies by Task
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey organizing perception research by visualization tasks; addresses how human visual perception informs effective graph design

sources.title: Preattentive Processing in Information Visualization
sources.notes: Explains how visual features processed in ~200ms before conscious attention can improve graph readability and pattern recognition

sources.title: Preattentive Visual Properties and How to Use Them in Information Visualization
sources.notes: Design guidance for leveraging preattentive processing through strategic use of color, orientation, and other visual properties in graph interfaces

sources.title: Scalable Readability Evaluation for Graph Layouts: 2D Geometric Distributed Algorithms
sources.notes: Computational methods for evaluating layout quality via metrics: crossing angle, edge length, node occlusion; enables automated layout optimization

sources.title: PREVis: Perceived Readability Evaluation for Visualizations
sources.notes: Measures perceived readability of graph layouts from human perspective rather than algorithmic metrics; informs design of more usable visualizations

sources.title: Cognitive Measurements of Graph Aesthetics
sources.notes: Empirical evaluation by Helen Purchase of graph aesthetics (edge crossings, symmetry) on user comprehension; validates aesthetic principles through controlled studies

sources.title: Experimenting with Aesthetics-Based Graph Layout
sources.notes: Experimental study validating relationship between graph drawing aesthetics and user task performance

sources.title: International Symposium on Graph Drawing and Network Visualization (GD)
sources.notes: Venue for peer-reviewed work on graph layout algorithms, aesthetics, and interaction techniques; major conference for graph visualization research

sources.title: Multiple and Coordinated Views in Information Visualization
sources.notes: Framework for designing linked multiple views supporting exploration; brushing/linking mechanisms enable cross-view pattern discovery

sources.title: Exploratory Visualization with Multiple Linked Views
sources.notes: Classic framework for multi-view exploratory systems enabling rapid hypothesis testing and pattern discovery

sources.title: Comparative Evaluation of the Scatter Plot Matrix and Parallel Coordinates Plot Matrix
sources.notes: Empirical comparison of interaction effectiveness between SPLOM and parallel coordinates; informs choice of representation for multivariate graph attributes

sources.title: Bertin's Visual Variables in Graphical Representation
sources.notes: Foundational theory (1967) categorizing seven visual variables for data encoding; informs principled visual encoding choices in graph design

sources.title: Graphical Perception: Theory, Experimentation, and Application to the Development of Graphical Methods
sources.notes: Seminal 1984 empirical study establishing hierarchy of visual encoding effectiveness; position > length > angle > area validates design choices

sources.title: Gestalt Principles for Data Visualization: Similarity, Proximity & Enclosure
sources.notes: Application of classic Gestalt psychology (proximity, similarity, closure) to improve grouping and structure perception in graph layouts

sources.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
sources.notes: Seminal textbook establishing principles: data-ink ratio, chartjunk reduction, graphical integrity; foundational for all visualization design

sources.title: The Design of Everyday Things: Principles of Interaction Design
sources.notes: Core HCI principles: affordances, signifiers, feedback, constraints, mapping; applies to graph interface design for discoverability and usability

sources.title: Information Foraging
sources.notes: Pirolli & Card's cognitive model explaining how users search and navigate information; informs design of scent cues in graph exploration

sources.title: Rational Analyses of Information Foraging on the Web
sources.notes: Theoretical framework and empirical validation of information seeking behavior; applies to understanding user strategies in graph exploration

sources.title: Scented Widgets: Improving Navigation Cues with Embedded Visualizations
sources.notes: Demonstrates embedding information scent cues (miniaturized previews) in UI widgets to guide navigation and reduce cognitive load

sources.title: The Effects of Information Scent on Visual Search in the Hyperbolic Tree Browser
sources.notes: Empirical study of how information scent cues affect user search performance in focus+context graph visualization

sources.title: Sensemaking with Interactive Data Visualization
sources.notes: Applies Pirolli & Card sensemaking framework to visualization design; iterative loops between evidence discovery and hypothesis formation

sources.title: Kyrix: Interactive Pan/Zoom Visualizations at Scale
sources.notes: System enabling smooth interactive pan/zoom of 100M data points through declarative optimization and rendering techniques

sources.title: GraphVista: Interactive Exploration of Large Graphs
sources.notes: Interactive system for exploring large graphs with spatial layout, filtering, and progressive refinement of results

sources.title: VISAGE: Interactive Visual Graph Querying
sources.notes: Visual query builder for graph databases combining force-directed layout with context menu exploration and result visualization

sources.title: GraphTQL: A Visual Query System for Graph Databases
sources.notes: Visual query interface using direct manipulation and progressive graph refinement for end-user query construction

sources.title: Difference Views for Visual Graph Query Building
sources.notes: Novel interaction technique using visual differences to show query changes and evolution during iterative graph query construction

sources.title: Reducing Large Graphs to Small Supergraphs: A Unified Approach
sources.notes: Techniques for graph compression through node/edge aggregation; enables scalable visualization while preserving essential structure

sources.title: Hierarchical Aggregation for Information Visualization: Overview, Techniques and Design Guidelines
sources.notes: Design patterns for multi-level aggregation enabling navigation from summary to detail in large graph visualizations

sources.title: Deck.gl: Large-scale Web-based Visual Analytics Made Easy
sources.notes: GPU-accelerated WebGL framework for interactive visualization of massive datasets; enables real-time pan/zoom of millions of entities

sources.title: D3 Force-Directed Graph Layout Module
sources.notes: Implementation of velocity Verlet physics simulation for graph layout; widely-used open-source library enabling interactive force-directed visualizations

sources.title: Gephi: Network Analysis and Visualization Tool
sources.notes: Open-source platform for interactive network exploration with layout algorithms, clustering, filtering, and temporal visualization

sources.title: Cytoscape: Open Source Software for Complex Network Analysis
sources.notes: Java-based platform for molecular and general network visualization; extensible with plugins for analysis, layout, and interaction

sources.title: NetworkAnalyst: Integrative Approaches for Protein-Protein Interaction Network Analysis
sources.notes: Domain-specific application of graph visualization to biological networks; demonstrates interaction design for specialized exploratory tasks

sources.title: Social Network Analysis and Visualization
sources.notes: Overview of SNA techniques and visualization approaches; explains centrality metrics and community structure visualization

sources.title: Network Centrality: Understanding Degree, Closeness and Betweenness Centrality
sources.notes: Practical guide to interpreting and visualizing centrality metrics; informs node importance representation in graph interfaces

sources.title: RDF Graph Visualization by Interpreting Linked Data as Knowledge
sources.notes: Addresses semantic web graph visualization challenges; techniques for large RDF/ontology graphs with heterogeneous node/edge types

sources.title: Hierarchical Knowledge Graphs: A Novel Information Representation for Exploratory Search Tasks
sources.notes: Framework for organizing knowledge graphs hierarchically; supports exploration from broad overview to detailed entity relationships

sources.title: Browsing Hierarchical Data with Multi-Level Dynamic Queries and Pruning
sources.notes: Combines treemaps with dynamic query controls and progressive refinement for efficient browsing of large hierarchies

sources.title: Dynamic Query Tools for Time Series Data Sets: Timebox Widgets for Interactive Exploration
sources.notes: Interaction design for temporal graph filtering; demonstrates slider/widget effectiveness for iterative data exploration

sources.title: Expressive Query Construction through Direct Manipulation of Nested Relational Results
sources.notes: Design pattern for visual query systems using direct manipulation rather than text-based queries; demonstrates improved learnability

sources.title: Suggested Interactivity: Seeking Perceived Affordances for Information Visualization
sources.notes: Framework for designing visible affordances indicating interactive possibilities in graph interfaces; improves feature discoverability

sources.title: What Is Discoverability?
sources.notes: HCI principles for making features visible and discoverable; applies to graph interface interaction patterns and menu design

sources.title: Touching Data: A Discoverability-based Evaluation of a Visualization Interface for Tablet Computers
sources.notes: Empirical evaluation of interaction affordances in touch-based visualization; informs mobile/tablet graph interface design

sources.title: Hierarchical Edge Bundling and Adjacency Relations in Hierarchical Data
sources.notes: Technique for visualizing hierarchical edges in compound graphs; reduces clutter while preserving implicit hierarchical relationships

sources.title: An Overview+Detail Layout for Visualizing Compound Graphs
sources.notes: Interaction pattern balancing overview and detail for hierarchical graphs; maintains context while supporting deep exploration

sources.title: TreeMatrix: A Hybrid Visualization of Compound Graphs
sources.notes: Combines node-link hierarchy with adjacency matrix for clusters; effective for both global and local structure comprehension

sources.title: Small MultiPiles: Piling Time to Explore Temporal Patterns in Dynamic Networks
sources.notes: Novel UI for temporal graph exploration combining small multiples with user-controlled stacking; enables pattern discovery across time

sources.title: The Effectiveness of Interactive Visualization Techniques for Time Navigation of Dynamic Graphs on Large Displays
sources.notes: Evaluation of interaction techniques (scrubber, slider, gesture) for temporal graph navigation on large-scale displays

sources.title: Interactive Visual Pattern Search on Graph Data via Graph Representation Learning
sources.notes: Combines neural graph embeddings with interactive exploration for subgraph pattern search; enables fast query-by-example

sources.title: Exploring the Limits of Complexity: A Survey of Empirical Studies on Graph Visualisation
sources.notes: Meta-analysis of graph visualization complexity factors and their effects on user performance; synthesizes findings on graph size, density, task

sources.title: Spotfire: Exploratory Data Analysis with Visual Analytics
sources.notes: Commercial embodiment of visual analytics principles; demonstrates integration of interactive visualization with analytical computation

sources.title: A Survey on Information Visualization: Recent Advances and Challenges
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey organizing visualization research into empirical methodologies, interactions, frameworks, and applications
